name: Fireball
rationale: Blaze, Powder and Emerald are extended by Fire Charge and Flint for the larger aimed fireball.
clues: Outer Plinths hold flame focus, firecharge motif; the other required ingredients use Inner Plinths.
Leave the second outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Leave the fourth outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Flame focus follows blank inscription clockwise.
Powder motif follows flame focus clockwise.
Evocation focus follows powder motif clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Firecharge motif follows evocation focus clockwise.
Flint motif follows firecharge motif clockwise.
Blank inscription follows flint motif clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
